items.statement: A moving coil galvanometer has a coil resistance of $G = 50.0\,\Omega$ and produces full-scale deflection for a current of $I_g = 2.0\text{ mA}$. To convert this galvanometer into an ammeter capable of measuring currents up to $I = 5.0\text{ A}$, the required shunt resistance $S$ to be connected in parallel is approximately:

A uniform circular disc of mass $M$ and radius $R$ is rotating freely about a fixed frictionless vertical axis passing through its center with angular velocity $\omega_0$. An insect of mass $m$ initially at the center begins crawling radially outward toward the edge of the disc. When the insect reaches the outer rim ($r = R$), the final angular velocity of the disc-insect system is:
For a quasi-static reversible adiabatic expansion of an ideal gas with constant heat capacity ratio $\gamma = C_p / C_v$, which of the following statements is/are correct?

options.A: The quantity $T V^{\gamma - 1}$ remains constant throughout the expansion.
options.B: The work done by the gas is equal to the decrease in its internal energy ($W = -\Delta U$).
options.C: The entropy of the gas remains invariant ($\Delta S = 0$).
options.D: The quantity $P V^\gamma$ remains constant throughout the expansion.

items.statement: A cylindrical copper wire of initial resistance $R_1 = 10.0\,\Omega$ is drawn uniformly through a series of dies such that its radius is reduced to half its initial radius ($r_2 = r_1 / 2$) without any loss of mass. Assuming the material density and resistivity remain constant, the new resistance of the wire in $\Omega$ is:

One mole of an ideal diatomic gas ($\gamma = 1.4$, $C_v = 2.5\,R$) at initial temperature $T_1 = 300\text{ K}$ is compressed adiabatically and reversibly such that its volume decreases by a factor of 32 ($V_2 = V_1 / 32$). Taking $R = 8.314\text{ J/(mol K)}$, calculate the final temperature $T_2$ of the gas in Kelvin.
